description: Java class 'SecretKeyWrapper' that manages wrapping and unwrapping SecretKey instances using Android's KeyStore with RSA encryption.

classes.name: SecretKeyWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps SecretKey instances using RSA keys stored in AndroidKeyStore, providing methods to wrap and unwrap symmetric keys.

methods.name: SecretKeyWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper, generating a key pair if necessary.

methods.name: generateKeyPair
methods.description: Static method to generate an RSA key pair with specified alias and validity period.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps a SecretKey using the public key with RSA encryption.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a previously wrapped SecretKey using the private key.
